nodes.label: S7 — Theming, Polish, App Review, Ship (research doc)
D68 — the Apple store pipeline runs first, before polish
nodes.rationale: Internal distribution was used through S0-S6; the store leg (cert, ASC record, store-signed upload, TestFlight) has never been exercised.

nodes.label: D69 — add ios.privacyManifests to app.config.ts
nodes.rationale: Expo does not generate PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy; Apple emails an automatic rejection within minutes of an upload missing required reason codes, and its tooling doesn't reliably parse pod-shipped manifests.

nodes.label: D70 — add /privacy and /support pages, exempted from the Auth0 login gate
nodes.rationale: App Store Connect requires a privacy policy URL and a support URL; the proxy's login redirect would hide them from Apple's link validator and the reviewer.

nodes.label: D71 — re-key 116 colour literals into a shared theme token table
nodes.rationale: The app is measurably inconsistent today — hard-coded dark styles under a declared automatic userInterfaceStyle.

nodes.label: D72 — ThemeProvider imported from expo-router, not @react-navigation/native
nodes.rationale: expo-router vendors its own react-navigation and does not depend on the @react-navigation/* package.

nodes.label: D73 — stable Tabs, not expo-router/unstable-native-tabs
nodes.rationale: The import path names the API as unstable; expo-router 57.0.13 proved the point by deprecating the root Tabs export in favor of expo-router/js-tabs.

nodes.label: D74 — ContentUnavailableView for the three genuine screen-level empty states
nodes.rationale: In-section notes like 'Details are being prepared…' are not empty states and stayed as themed muted text.

nodes.label: D75 — no crash/error reporting SDK added
nodes.rationale: The tester list is one person who can reproduce directly; an SDK means a new privacy-manifest sweep and data-collection label; real failures are already observable server-side.

nodes.label: D76 — internal TestFlight only for v1, plus a populated demo account and explicit 2.5.4 review notes
nodes.rationale: External distribution needs Beta App Review for no benefit with one tester; a reviewer who can't reach a live session behind a locked screen will reject the audio background mode.

nodes.label: D77 — settle sendContextualUpdate measurement at S7
nodes.rationale: S7 touches the tutor screen for theming anyway, so the measurement carried unmeasured since S4 is finally free.

nodes.label: D78 — clear the expo-doctor SDK-57 patch drift before the store build
nodes.rationale: Shipping a v1 that expo-doctor reports unhealthy makes every future failure ambiguous.
